title: Caffè Latte
desc: Rich, full-bodied espresso in steamed milk with a light layer of foam.

title: Caramel Macchiato
desc: Freshly steamed milk with vanilla-flavored syrup marked with espresso and topped with caramel drizzle.

title: Cappuccino
desc: Dark, rich espresso lies in wait under a smoothed and stretched layer of thick milk foam.

title: Java Chip Frappuccino
desc: We blend mocha sauce and Frappuccino chips with coffee, milk and ice, then top it off with whipped cream and mocha drizzle.

title: Caffè Mocha
desc: We combine our rich, full-bodied espresso with bittersweet mocha sauce and steamed milk, then top it off with sweetened whipped cream.

title: Iced Brown Sugar Oatmilk Shaken Espresso
desc: We shake Starbucks® Blonde espresso, brown sugar and cinnamon together, and then top it off with oatmilk and ice.

title: Flat White
desc: Smooth ristretto shots of espresso get just the right amount of steamed whole milk to create a not-too-strong, not-too-creamy, just-right flavor.

title: Matcha Tea Latte
desc: Smooth and creamy matcha sweetened just right and served with steamed milk.

title: Cold Brew
desc: Slow-steeped in cool water for 20 hours, without touching heat.

title: Chai Tea Latte
desc: Black tea infused with cinnamon, clove and other warming spices is combined with steamed milk and topped with foam.
